symbols.note: copied by hand from gatekit symbols system --dll dx11 (addresses are bg3_dx11.exe). Methods with null address were listed by the Toolkit but the tool printed no game address for them. System index variable bg3_dx11.exe+0x60D9788; the game functions using the index are in the Toolkit line of the tool output. The does layer cites EoCServer.dll (Toolkit pseudo-code with real names) wherever bg3_dx11.exe functions were not individually mapped.
symbols.limits: reads/writes: the component views in the parameters of the system's exported methods. uses: the component operations (add, remove, get, has) its per-frame update performs through the engine's out-of-line helpers, itself or in a function it calls (depth 2), with the call site; kind index: a matched method reads the type's index and the operation is not known. Not listed: operations the compiler inlined, those deeper than depth 2, and what a method that is not the update does (e.g. a SystemLoad) - read its pseudo-code; an empty writes list is not "writes nothing".

does.text: Calls ProcessAddedMembers; a guess from the name: it unregisters members that went into an inventory from the level.
